title: senna lasseigniana var. canarensis
intro: Senna lasseigniana var. canarensis, commonly known as the Indian Senna, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family that is native to the Indian subcontinent. The Indian Senna is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, where it provides relief from constipation and diarrhea due to its laxative properties, and is also used to treat fever and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Senna lasseigniana var. canarensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include glycosides such as sennosides A and B, that stimulate bowel movements and relax the smooth muscle of the intestines. The health benefits of the Indian Senna include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic potential in treating various health conditions.
